headline: Highest risk is medium data leakage: Perplexity uploads documents and browsing context while Argo Workflows handles artifacts/parameters, creating a plausible shared-data path; prompt injection and capability conflict are lower.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Argo Workflows has no browser or MCP surface, so it is not directly exposed to Perplexity’s web content. The only plausible bridge is manual transfer of Perplexity outputs into Argo inputs or artifacts, which is an unusual configuration and a limited blast radius. No stronger shared channel is documented.
conditions: IF Perplexity outputs are manually copied into Argo workflow parameters or artifact contents
IF Argo steps treat copied text as executable instructions or templated commands
mitigations: Use a strict copy/paste policy for prompts and workflow specs
Add a review step before any Argo template consumes Perplexity text
Strip instructions from imported text before passing it to workflows
requires-engineering: add provenance labels to imported content

B_data_leakage.rationale: Perplexity explicitly handles uploaded documents and browsing context, while Argo Workflows touches artifacts and parameters. If the same sensitive file or parameter set is routed through both, Perplexity may ingest it for analysis and expose it in generated answers. The pairwise path is plausible in default usage, but the profiles do not show automatic sharing, so medium fits better than high.
conditions: IF the same document or parameter bundle is uploaded to Perplexity and then reused in Argo artifacts
IF Perplexity outputs are stored in Argo-visible artifacts containing sensitive data
mitigations: Avoid uploading secrets or regulated data to Perplexity
Redact sensitive fields before analysis
Keep Argo artifacts and Perplexity uploads in separate folders
Delete transient uploads after analysis
requires-engineering: enforce data-class filtering between systems

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Argo Workflows can call REST/GRPC APIs and use allowlisted egress, while Perplexity is vendor-hosted with vendor-only egress and no host execution. There is no shared write surface, no git mutation, and no filesystem write overlap, so direct capability conflict is limited. Uncertainty is low because the profiles explicitly block the main conflict surfaces.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same mutable external API resource
IF Argo workflow steps and Perplexity sessions write to the same downstream system without coordination
mitigations: Separate API credentials per system
Use idempotent writes where possible
Add a manual approval step before shared-resource updates
requires-engineering: add locking around shared external resources

D_cascading_error.rationale: Perplexity is a search-answer engine that produces cited outputs, and Argo can consume parameters and artifacts in downstream workflows. If Argo treats Perplexity’s answer as authoritative, an error can cascade into workflow decisions or generated artifacts. The profiles do not prove automatic action-taking, so medium is appropriate rather than high.
conditions: IF Argo workflow logic uses Perplexity output as an input parameter without verification
IF downstream steps act on Perplexity-generated facts or citations
mitigations: Require human review before using Perplexity output in workflows
Validate cited facts against source documents
Add schema checks for expected output fields
requires-engineering: insert a verification stage before downstream actions

E_compliance.rationale: Both profiles are docs-only and do not show PHI handling, residency mismatch, or special certifications. Perplexity does process uploaded documents and browsing context, while Argo touches artifacts and parameters, so a compliance issue is possible only if regulated data is routed through both. The evidence is insufficient for a stronger finding, so low is the highest supportable severity.
conditions: IF regulated data such as PHI or EU PII is uploaded to Perplexity and then stored in Argo artifacts
IF organizational policy requires a residency or retention guarantee not documented in either profile
mitigations: Do not route regulated data through Perplexity
Check vendor privacy terms before use
Keep retention periods short for shared artifacts
requires-engineering: document residency and retention controls
